free_tier_limits: API access is free for Tradier Brokerage account holders; trading, market-data subscriptions, and regulatory fees may apply (exact free request caps are not a separate published free-tier quota).
rate_limits: Production Standard and Market Data: 120 requests/minute; production Trading: 60 requests/minute; sandbox: 60 requests/minute for all three categories, per access token.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: AUDITOR RIGHT. Official getting-started/docs and brokerage/developer materials indicate API access is free for account holders rather than gated on a funded-account requirement; original “production requires funded account” framing overstates the free-tier limit. Evidence: https://docs.tradier.com/docs/getting-started and https://production.tradier.com/businesses/fintechs. rate_limits: AUDITOR RIGHT. Tradier publishes an explicit rate-limit table (production Standard/Market Data 120/min, Trading 60/min; sandbox 60/min all categories, per token). Original “not fully published” is incorrect. Evidence: https://docs.tradier.com/docs/rate-limiting. Undisputed fields left null; status remains operational (API not defunct).
